question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Full of people
solution:
The correct one-word substitute is** 'Populous'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **Let's understand the meaning of the marked option:

 
 
• **Populous -** .full of residents or inhabitants, as a region; heavily populated **(घनी आबादी वाला).**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meanings of the other given option:
 
 
• **Popular - **liked by many people or by most people in a group **(लोकप्रिय, अधिकतर लोगों को पसंद).**
 
• **Prominent -** easy to see, noticeable, situated so as to catch the attention;** (साफ़ दीखने वाला; जो आसानी से दीख सके).**
 
• **Porous - **mushy, (of rock or other material) having minute spaces or holes through which liquid or air may pass**(छिद्रिल;ऐसा कि द्रव या हवा रिस** **सके). **
 
 

​ Hence, from the given meanings, we find that **Populous** is the correct **one-word substitute.**
